object.attr: analysis: changing a link's type by removing and adding it records the target's last change, which turns a suspect link OK with nothing reviewed (CF-T39; requirements review Q36). Answered on 2026-11-10.
object.description: When one update_object call or one change of link type in the Inspector removes a link and adds one between the same objects, Mellon shall give the added link the removed link's acknowledged commit.
